closedFindings.status: closed in frozen source; actual Native regression remains authored/unexecuted
closedFindings.resolution: Initial load/reload now belongs to the same Coordinator task/generation. A replacement captures, cancels and awaits its predecessor. Native setCookie callbacks are all awaited without cancellation short-circuit; notify only resumes and never starts HTTP. Every initial admission, pre-IPC step and resumed load checks the current generation/page token, with awaited pages also rechecking the real Host/deadline. Explicit stop seals future loads/navigation before stopping WebKit/cancelling handles; final Presenter drain awaits latest initial chain and confirmation before releasing receipt/queue.
closedFindings.nonawaitBoundary: All original pages install controls and an explicit ticket-only load check. Nonawait uses the same ticket token with distantFuture, allowing its accepted page and pending initial load to survive normal producer/session/revoke completion. Explicit UI cancellation invalidates that token and seals/stops/drains navigation. No normal producer cleanup is reinterpreted as page cancellation.
closedFindings.effectsBoundary: SeedIssued is recorded before real IPC and SeedCompleted only after real callbacks. Already-issued native Cookie changes cannot be rolled back and are not claimed undone; preventing later HTTP/load and awaiting issued callbacks are the repair guarantees.

rechecked: The latest initial task retains the complete reload chain; old-task defer clears only its own still-current generation, and cancellation seals generation first so it cannot erase the captured drain handle.
Separate Presenter finish task drains initial/confirmation. An initial or confirmation callback may request dismissal but never awaits that drain, so this path does not create self-await.

Internal per-Coordinator seeder defaults to actual WKHTTPCookieStore.setCookie. Test-only holding is permitted only after a real native callback; no global success override/new Cookie store/network/owner is added.

Original same-page close/challenge/manual Done versus visible Cancel, atomic URL+DOM snapshot, true refetch confirmation, strict sourceRunHandler:nil and guarded terminal Cookie capture retain the reviewed v1 contract.
